campus_background_no_campus.why: The background harmonics upload, a measurement file the user uploads in the app, needs a campus file with a PCC bus first; the user builds the campus, then uploads the measurement.

campus_background_unreadable.why: The background harmonics upload, a measurement file the user uploads in the app, has a stored copy that cannot be read back; the user removes it and uploads the measurement again.

campus_background_too_large.why: The background harmonics upload, a measurement file the user uploads in the app, refuses a file over the size cap; the user uploads a shorter measurement.

campus_background_invalid.why: The background harmonics upload, a measurement file the user uploads in the app, refuses a source, date or file name that is too long; the user shortens that field.
